result.paraphrase:
Abstract

Background
RNA-sequencing (RNA-seq) has seen a substantial rise in use in molecular biology research and clinical practice over the last decade. Even with its broad adoption, there are few simple, interactive tools for analyzing and exploring RNA-seq data. Many widely used tools also demand programming skills or knowledge of Unix/Bash to analyze and visualize results, creating a major obstacle for researchers who need to work with RNA-seq data efficiently and present it clearly.

Results
We present a browser-based tool for the Exploration and Visualization of RNA-seq data. This easy-to-use application enables interactive RNA-seq analysis and exploration. Built in R, it uses  as its engine for differential gene expression (DGE) analysis, while requiring no prior knowledge of R or . With it, researchers can quickly produce a table of differentially expressed genes with statistical testing and then display the results through a range of graphs, plots, and heatmaps. Users can also adjust many statistical testing parameters, variance handling, clustering methods, and pathway analysis settings to create high-quality figures.

Conclusion
This tool simplifies analysis for novice users and also speeds up the RNA-seq workflow for experts by automating several steps. It and its documentation are available on GitHub at https://github.com/developerpiru/BEAVR. It is also offered as a Docker container at https://hub.docker.com/r/pirunthan/beavr.
